visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with blonde hair tied in a ponytail and wearing glasses enters through a white door. She is dressed in a white long-sleeved shirt and carries a black messenger bag. On the door, a whiteboard with handwritten Chinese characters "模擬考" (Mock Exam) and a graph is visible. She holds a book and a pointer, assuming a teacher persona. (2) The woman stands in front of the door, pointing at the whiteboard with a retractable metal pointer. She wears a headset microphone and expressive facial features, acting out a dramatic scene. The lighting is bright and even, typical of an indoor home or studio setting. Behind her, shelves with anime-style figurines and posters are partially visible. (3) In a series of jump cuts, the woman performs various teacher-like actions. She shouts towards the camera, adjusts her glasses, and uses the pointer for emphasis. In one segment, another person's hand appears, and she pretends to hit it with the pointer as a form of "loving punishment." She maintains high energy throughout, with frequent changes in hand gestures. (4) She transitions to a segment where she erases the whiteboard with a whiteboard eraser. She holds a different set of papers and pamphlets while continuing her theatrical performance. The background remains consistent, emphasizing the door and the attached whiteboard as the central stage for the different parodied scenarios. (5) The final phase shows the woman from behind, writing on the whiteboard with a black marker. Floating heart emojis and variety-show style text appear on screen. The camera remains static at eye level, capturing her movements as she concludes the video with a question directed at the audience.
